Pathfinder Toolkit › Bestiary › Level 9

Megalodon

Creature 9 uncommonGargantuananimalaquatic

Perception +20 blood scent; scent (imprecise) 100 feet

Skills Athletics +21, Stealth +19, Survival +16

Str +8, Dex +2, Con +5, Int −4, Wis +3, Cha −2

Blood Scent The megaladon can smell blood in the water from up to 1 mile away.

AC 27; Fort +21, Ref +16, Will +17

HP 180

Speed swim 80 feet

Melee ◆ jaws +22 [+17/+12] (reach 10 feet, unarmed), Damage 2d12+10 piercing plus Improved Grab

Melee ◆ tail +22 [+18/+14] (agile, reach 15 feet), Damage 2d8+10 piercing plus Push 15 feet

Breach ◆ (attack, move) The megalodon Swims up to its swim Speed, then Leaps vertically out of the water up to 25 feet high, making a Strike against a creature at any point during the jump (this lets it attack a creature within 35 feet of the water's surface or 40 feet with its tail). After the Strike, the megalodon splashes back down into the water.

Savage ◆ Requirements The megalodon hit with a jaws Strike on its most recent action this turn.

Effect The creature the megalodon hit takes 2d12 slashing damage.

Swallow Whole ◆ (attack) Huge, 2d8+5 bludgeoning, Rupture 20

Swallows a grabbed foe of the listed size; the foe takes damage each turn and can cut its way out by dealing the Rupture damage.

Improved Grab ◇ Like Grab, but it can grab as a free action.

Push 15 feet ◆ After a hit, it shoves the target away for one more action.

👹 Build an Encounter ⚔️ Add to Initiative

Where to meet one

The Pathfinder Encounter Builder rolls the megalodon for fights in 🏖️ coast and 🌊 at sea.
